description: The National Center on School Infrastructure offers free tools for school districts to carry out facility condition assessments (FCAs). The Facility Condition Assessment Manual and Workbook lets any district gather information on its buildings, assemble it in spreadsheet form and analyse conditions, using an Excel workbook organised by the Uniformat Level III classification of building elements and designed for single-building assessments. The FCA Scope Definition Worksheet and Guide helps districts draft requests for proposals when consultants carry out FCAs, defining objectives, inspection depth, deliverable formats and budget in 14 structured sections. The blog page, read through WebFetch because the site blocked automated access, says the resources were updated on 5 May 2026 and links a webinar of October 2025. Coverage: designed for US K-12 school districts. Access: free downloads. Licence: not stated on the page read. Caveats: templates, not data; results depend on the assessor. Simulation uses: a consistent element-level structure for school condition data that feed capital planning and deterioration models. Related records: the UK school estate condition data collection and the Global Library of School Infrastructure.
